# Optional MS2PIP environment for the desktop application.
#
# Separate from env/console-requirements.txt because it has to be: at the versions
# this project tests, MS2PIP and DeepLC cannot share an environment.
#
#   deeplc==4.1.1 -> psm-utils>=1.5 -> sqlalchemy>=2
#   ms2pip==4.0.0 -> sqlalchemy>=1.3,<2
#
# Needed only for FASTA-mode library building with predicted fragment intensities.
# The recommended workflow imports a library instead and never invokes MS2PIP.
#
# Pinned to the version the project tests. `ms2pip>=4.1` resolves alongside DeepLC
# and would collapse this back into one environment, but it changes predicted
# intensities, so it is an upgrade to measure rather than to assume.
ms2pip==4.0.0
numpy
pandas
